optionalManifestBundles.label: Background audio recording
optionalManifestBundles.warning: Requesting FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE triggers Play Console policy review — Google requires a clear, prominent in-app disclosure and justification before you can publish.
optionalManifestBundles.nextSteps: Pass `allowsBackgroundRecording: true` to setAudioModeAsync so recording keeps running with the app backgrounded.

infoPlistKeys.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: This app uses the microphone to record audio.
